patches.summary: Added repeated --host-id support to events create and aligned surfaced event command descriptions.
patches.reason: Le Wagon Meetup creation must propagate all Host ID values from Notion; the generated create path omitted hosts and the surfaced help/context under-described update/publish capabilities.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/... passed; events create help shows --host-id; agent-context exposes events update/publish/hosts and create host-id.

patches.summary: Changed editEvent topic updates to send a flat list of topic IDs and documented the Notion Topics format.
patches.reason: The live Meetup editEvent mutation rejected topic objects with invalid_arguments; Le Wagon's Notion-to-Meetup workflow needs Topics values like '<id> - <name>' to map deterministically into repeated --topic-id flags.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/... passed; live updates on events 316286812 and 316286814 succeeded; gql get-event showed topics 488822, 788002, and 1521079 on both drafts.

patches.summary: Added events create-from-notion to create validated city draft(s), attach the Notion image, map hosts/topics, and callback returned URLs.
patches.reason: Le Wagon needs a deterministic one-command creation workflow from the canonical Notion page rather than manual extraction and repeated CLI flags.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/... passed; command help verified; dry run against canonical page safely detected its missing Meetup URL Montreal callback property before any Meetup mutation.

patches.summary: Mapped Hybrid Notion events to Montréal onsite and Toronto online Meetup records while retaining one canonical registration URL.
patches.reason: Le Wagon Demo Days use one Eventbrite registration page with city-specific delivery: onsite in Montréal and online in Toronto.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli passed; hybrid dry-run for the 2026-12-11 Demo Day resolves both city targets without a publication mutation.
